content: Tiny ERP API v3 (via ajuda.olist.com) enforces per-minute rate limits and exposes an account-info endpoint returning API usage/consumption metrics. Webhooks exist specifically for stock updates ('Webhooks atualizações de estoque') notifying integrators of any stock change for mapped products; the receiving endpoint must return HTTP 200 to ack. This confirms webhook-driven stock sync is a first-class, documented pattern for Tiny, not something to build from polling alone.
